thread:
Priya Nair: Quick sync — DataBridge POC kickoff. Customer wants a sandbox with ~5k sample docs, redaction in pipeline, and an eval harness. Need recommended access pattern + success KPIs. cc @Bethany (SE)
Samir Patel: Do they insist on VPC private connectivity or is S3 presigned URL ok? That changes our setup and timeline.
Priya Nair: Customer prefers S3 for speed but can do VPC later. They asked about ephemeral creds for security.
Bethany (SE): For a short 2-week POC presigned S3 + client-side redaction is fastest. If they want server-side redaction we can show Redwood's redaction hook but that'll add a day to setup.
Matt Gomez: Pricing Q — if they spike above free trial, they'll ask about Dedicated burst. We can offer a short reserved window for the POC at a discounted flat fee. Need to confirm expected QPS.
Priya Nair: Customer estimate: 10 QPS peak, average 2–3 QPS. Main success criteria: (1) >= 95% accuracy on 10 prompt evals (we'll provide ground truth), (2) end-to-end latency < 600ms median, (3) stable responses under 10 QPS for 4 hours straight.
Elaine Cho: For accuracy we should define the eval prompt set and scoring rubric. Bethany, can you draft 8–12 prompts covering their top-3 intents?
Bethany (SE): Sure. I'll push a draft to the shared drive later today. Also propose we run batch evals nightly and attach simple pass/fail thresholds.
Samir Patel: On creds: recommend using short-lived STS role assumption. Example for them to run once to upload sample data:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPOCRole --role-session-name db-poc-upload
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...\nexport AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...\nexport AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
aws s3 cp sample-data/ s3://redwood-db-poc-bucket/ --recursive
```

Samir Patel: We can also accept presigned URLs if they prefer not to share any AWS creds.
Priya Nair: Redaction: they said sample set contains customer emails and partial account numbers. We told them client-side redact first, but asked if we can run an automated scrub pipeline to remove emails and mask digits.
Elaine Cho: We have a simple regex-based scrub we can run as a pre-ingest step. If they need PHI-level redaction, mark as out-of-scope for the POC and recommend on-prem/Private deployment.
Matt Gomez: Security questionnaire flag: they asked about encryption at rest and access logs. Answer: S3 encryption (AES256/KMS) + request-level audit in Console. Also note we can provide a short SOC2 summary for the POC.
Priya Nair: Timeline proposal: Day 0–1: creds & bucket + sample data upload; Day 2: redaction run + onboarding; Day 3–7: evals and prompt tuning; Day 8–14: stability run & final report. Any blockers?
Bethany (SE): Blocker — we need customer's list of top-3 intents and 12 labeled examples by Day 1. I'll send a template.
Samir Patel: Another blocker: VPC peering requests require their infra team and can take ~5 business days. Don't promise VPC for the 2-week POC.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll ask them to sign the short CSR and provide sample labels. Also they'll accept presigned URLs to avoid IAM changes.
Elaine Cho: For monitoring — enable per-route tracing and cost/latency alerts in Console. I'll pre-configure a dashboard and share a link once running.
Matt Gomez: Pricing note: for the POC we can cap spend at $X/day — set quota and alerts.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. Next steps: Bethany to send prompt template + eval rubric; Samir to share STS & presigned URL instructions; Elaine to prep dashboard; I'll confirm sample upload method with DataBridge and get labels.
deploy-bot: deployment: redwood-poc-scrub-runner scheduled for 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC — status queued :hourglass:
Priya Nair: FYI I looped in Alice from DataBridge via email, she confirmed they'll aim to upload ~5k docs tonight via presigned links. I'll update when done. :thumbsup:
